journey.name: Switch Movie Categories
journey.description: Tests the filtering logic by switching between Ghibli movie genres (e.g., All, Fantasy, Drama) and verifying the content changes.

actions.action: Wait for the app to load and ensure the "Ghibli Garden" home screen is visible.
Scroll down slightly until the category tabs (e.g., "All", "Fantasy", "Drama", "Adventure", "Family") are visible.
Verify that the "All" tab is selected by default (it should have a different background color).
Note the title of the first movie in the grid under the "All" category.
Wait for the movie grid to refresh. The screen might show a quick transition animation.
Verify that the movies now displayed are filtered. If "Castle in the Sky" or "My Neighbor Totoro" appears, it's likely correct for Fantasy.
Verify that the movie list updates to show Drama films like "Grave of the Fireflies".
Tap back on the "All" tab and ensure the full list of movies is displayed again.
